about_the_game:
We invite you to add our game to your WISHLIST!

Valentina: The Last Witch

Valentina, a formidable witch, is the last one capable of wielding the forces of hell. With unparalleled power, she can battle demons... or unleash devastation upon the innocent. The apocalypse looms, demons overrun the world, and prayers to the gods go unanswered. Yet, faith hasn't vanished; it's mutated into a fervent frenzy, with witch trials becoming humanity's twisted catharsis. Innocent women burn on fiery crosses, their cries unheard, as Valentina watches, devoid of sorrow or joy, observing these deluded zealots.

And you, Pure Monk John, led by your Father, forge a pact with Valentina, the last witch. Only by maintaining your purity can you shackle this demonic power, compelling the witch to temporarily fight for humanity. Your consciousness will forever intertwine with hers, submerged in a shared subconscious...

Deploy & Sacrifice: Cage Your Villagers!

In each stage, villagers are chosen as Watchkeepers. They enhance your structures, some even possess unique abilities: poison damage for your army, flame damage for your arrow towers, and immense aid in battle. Strategically assign them to structures in the deployment interface to perfect your defense plan. Valentina can also sacrifice these assigned villagers to unleash devastating magic, swiftly obliterating enemies across the entire map.

The Villagers' Fate: Your Control

When structures fall, these villagers flee helplessly, perhaps to be slaughtered by demons... Is it better to sacrifice them yourself than to let monsters claim them? Or will you heed your conscience and escort them to safety? The choice is yours. Each Watchkeeper has their own life path and ending, and your decisions will shape their destiny...

Devise Tactics, Build Defenses: Pure Bliss

You can equip your witch with active and passive skills, choose powerful effects generated by sacrificing villager lives, select building upgrade paths and their附加 effects, and even determine the types of soldiers produced in the barracks and their enhanced abilities upon upgrading.

These numerous choices will create chain reactions among themselves, leading to outcomes where the sum is greater than its individual parts (1+1 > 2).

In the end, do you want to take this challenge?

short_description: Forge a pact with Valentina, the last witch, to weave magic and talent into diverse builds. As doomsday approaches, stand with the Nightwatch against endless demonic hordes. The fate of the Nightwatch villagers rests in your hands: sacrifice or protect, the choice is yours.
